# FAQ Update Checklist — [Client] — [Month]

The assistant is only as good as its knowledge. Verify each month; ask the client only for what changed.

## Ask the client (or check their site/socials)

- [ ] Any change to services offered?
- [ ] Any change to prices?
- [ ] Any change to business hours (including upcoming holidays)?
- [ ] Any change to location, parking, or contact details?
- [ ] Any new promotion, package, or seasonal offer?
- [ ] Any staff/availability change that affects bookings?

## Review the assistant

- [ ] Read this month's conversations for questions the assistant answered poorly or not at all
- [ ] Add new FAQs for any repeated unanswered question
- [ ] Rewrite any answer that confused customers
- [ ] Remove or update outdated answers
- [ ] Confirm escalation triggers (what the AI should NOT answer) are still right

## Apply & verify

- [ ] Knowledge base updated
- [ ] Re-test 3–5 of the changed answers in the live widget
- [ ] Log the changes for the monthly optimization report (section 4)
